title: kaiak usage batch
description: The body of POST /v1/usage: one batch of usage records under its batch ID (docs/specs/CONTROL-PROTOCOL.md, Usage batches).

records.description: 1 to 500 records, each from this batch's instance, record IDs unique.

batch_id.description: Identifies a batch: the control plane counts each batch once per instance.

epoch.description: Random, 128 bits, lowercase hex; created at every gateway process start.

sequence.description: Increases by one per batch within the epoch, from 1.
